##### Project general facts

Swoi Berawa offers a collection of thoughtfully designed studio apartments located in the heart of Canggu’s most dynamic neighborhood. Developed by Swoi Development Group, this exclusive project is crafted for the social, sports, and surf community, combining modern comfort with smart investment potential. With a long-term leasehold structure and quality construction backed by an extensive warranty, these apartments represent a hassle-free opportunity in one of Bali’s most prestigious areas.

Residents enjoy a prime location surrounded by world-famous restaurants, bars, and beach clubs, all within walking distance. Each apartment is finished to Western standards, featuring durable materials including aluminum, steel, and stone. Private balconies, air conditioning, premium plumbing fixtures, and built-in wardrobes are thoughtfully integrated, creating a comfortable and functional living space designed for tropical living.

Every apartment at Swoi Berawa is delivered fully furnished, with interiors designed to maximize space, natural light, and cross ventilation. Western finishing standards ensure a sleek, contemporary aesthetic, with durable materials chosen for longevity and ease of maintenance. From the fully equipped kitchen to the premium fixtures and finishes, each detail reflects a commitment to quality, comfort, and modern tropical living.

##### Parking
Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in the heart of Berawa within Badung regency, this exceptional location places residents at the epicenter of Canggu’s social and lifestyle scene. Berawa is renowned as a hub of famous restaurants, bars, beach clubs, and nightclubs, offering top occupancy and rental rates in Bali. Just a short walk from Berawa Beach and its legendary surf spots, the area attracts a vibrant international community of surfers, digital nomads, and creatives.

The location is distinguished by its unbeatable convenience and thriving business environment. Within easy reach are the island’s top three beach clubs, a variety of dining and nightlife venues, clinics, hospitals, and Bali International Airport. The central location allows for quick access to other key areas of the island, making it ideal for both short-term visitors and long-term residents.

For those seeking a residence that embodies energy, convenience, and prestige, Berawa delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of world-class amenities, strong rental demand, and vibrant community makes it one of Bali’s most desirable addresses. This is a place where every day feels like a holiday, connected, exciting and effortlessly inspiring.
